metadata.title: Email Identity and Delegation Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the architectural pattern for identity, authentication, authorization, and delegation associated with institutional email services. This pattern is vendor-agnostic and expresses security and governance intent only.

components.title: Email Identity and Delegation
components.description: Ensures that access to institutional email services is bound to verified identities, supports delegated access where appropriate, and maintains accountability and auditability for all actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email services must use enterprise-managed identity for authentication and attribution.
Email systems must support delegated access in a controlled and explicitly authorized manner.
Least privilege principles must be applied to email access and delegation.
Actions performed via delegated or direct email access must be auditable.

components.remarks: This pattern establishes the architectural requirements for identity binding and delegation in email systems. Product-specific identity providers, protocols (e.g., OAuth, SAML), tenant configurations, and lifecycle considerations are defined in realization artifacts.
